'''KULA''' is the decentralized-finance (DeFi) '''reward token''' of the [[SoapBox]] ecosystem — the token, the decentralized exchange ('''KulaSwap'''), and the collateral system that live on the compute chain [[PRANA]]. Where [[MELEK]] is the social coin and PRANA is the mining coin, KULA is the '''DeFi coin''' that ties value across the ecosystem together.

'''KULA is not a stablecoin.''' It has no dollar peg and no redemption claim — the ecosystem ships no "backed dollar" (MELEK deliberately dropped that idea). KULA's value is whatever the market sets, like any DeFi token.

== What KULA is ==

KULA is a '''PRC-20''' token (an ERC-20 on PRANA — see [https://witness.melek.salon/tokens Token standards]), '''minted on a schedule that decays about 10% a year'''. It is a reward token with three jobs:

* '''A mining / liquidity / lotto reward.''' KULA is paid out to '''[[PRANA]] miners''', to a '''LOTTO''', and to '''liquidity providers''' on KulaSwap.
* '''The DEX base asset''' — the pairing asset of '''KulaSwap''', a Uniswap-V2-style automated market maker where any PRC-20 can be pooled and swapped.
* '''DeFi collateral (a CDP)''' — lock KULA into a '''Collateralized Debt Position''' to '''borrow wrapped MELEK (wMELEK)''' against it, MakerDAO-style: over-collateralized, and liquidatable if it falls under-water. This is the on-chain bridge of value between KULA and [[MELEK]] — not a stable-dollar mechanism.

== MWALI and SHELLS ==

KULA sits in a small family of tokens named for the '''Kula ring''' (the Trobriand shell-exchange: ''kula'' the exchange, ''mwali'' the armshell, and the shells themselves):

* '''MWALI''' is the '''KulaSwap liquidity token''' (formerly called "Proof-of-Liquidity" / PoL). It is earned '''per block''' for providing liquidity, and can be '''burned''' to mint '''KULA''' or '''lotto tickets'''.
* '''SHELLS''' is the '''ve-style governance''' token — a future layer for locking and voting on the DeFi system.

== KulaSwap ==

KulaSwap is the on-chain exchange: swap tab, liquidity pools, yield farms, and the borrow/CDP calculators, all over tested models. Because PRANA is EVM, KulaSwap trades any PRC-20 — including '''wrapped''' assets bridged in from other chains ('''wMELEK''', '''wVKBT''', '''wCURE'''), so value from [[MELEK]] and the Hive-Engine side can trade here through a K-of-N federated bridge.

== KULA and PRANA mining ==

Miners of [[PRANA]] earn '''PRANA''', and '''KULA''' is minted alongside it to miners, LPs, and the lotto. KULA is the piece that makes that a real DeFi economy — a DEX, farms, and collateral — rather than just a second coin.

== Opening pairs ==

'''wMELEK/KULA''', '''wVKBT/KULA''', and '''wCURE/KULA''' are planned as the first trading pairs — being stood up, not yet live. wMELEK is [[MELEK]] bridged in from its own chain (via the deposit/custody bridge); wVKBT and wCURE bridge in from the Hive-Engine side.

== Where KULA fits ==

KULA is the '''DeFi''' layer: [[MELEK]] (social), [[PRANA]] (compute), and '''KULA''' (DeFi — the KulaSwap DEX, rewards, and KULA→wMELEK collateral). The apps that use all three are [[SoapBox]].
